# Probabilistic Thinking

## Definition
Thinking in probabilities means evaluating choices based on expected outcome distributions rather than binary certainty.

## Mathematical Formulation
Expected Value (EV) = (P_win * Reward) - (P_loss * Risk)

## Rules in ZERO Engine
* Never take a setup where EV <= 0.
* Respect the Conformal Prediction Intervals (P10-P90) generated by calibrator.py.
